Hannah —

Thanks for the thorough packet. Quick read: the base and sign-on look fine. Two notes from my side:

1) Equity: 12k RSUs is slightly above our typical midpoint for IC3 in SF/Bay Area. Given candidate's background (strong pre-sales at comparable infra startup), I'm OK approving up to 14k if it helps close, but recommend we tie the uplift to a 2-year retention clawback if they leave in <24 months.

2) Bonus: 15% feels light for quota-bearing sales-facing role. Typically we do 18–20% for IC3s on quota. If we keep 15% we should increase sign-on to compensate — or make bonus 18% and reduce sign-on to $10k.

If you want, Laura can weigh in on equity cadence; otherwise I'm comfortable approving if we land at either: (A) Base 165k / Bonus 18% / Equity 12k + $15k sign-on OR (B) Base 165k / Bonus 15% / Equity 14k / Sign-on 10k.
